summary: Frontend + integration testing of Task Manager rework (rename, urgent pill, added-date/days-ago, days-to-due, checklist virtual rows, DAR prefill, gradient banner). All requested behaviours verified end-to-end as exec.test@example.com.

test_results.nav_and_heading: PASS - sidebar label 'Task Manager' (Layout.jsx line 204) and /tasks header <h1> reads 'Task Manager'.
test_results.gradient_banner: PASS - header has bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-600 via-violet-600 to-fuchsia-600.
test_results.add_urgent_todo: PASS - Mark urgent checkbox toggles, POST /api/todos includes urgent:true, row renders todo-urgent-pill-<id> and rose-50/60 row background.
test_results.added_date_days_elapsed: PASS - todo-added-<id> shows 'Added 11 Sept 26 · today' (elapsedLabel handles today/1 day/N days).
test_results.days_to_due_and_overdue: PASS - 'Due 01 Dec (in 81d)' rendered for future date; 'Due 01 Sept (in -10d)' shows overdue styling; existing overdue todos show '(Nd ago)'. Minor: due-in value uses negative number for past dates in the non-overdue branch (only visible if due==today edge? verified overdue branch used - no bug).
test_results.checklist_virtual_rows: PASS - Two rows with data-testid todo-checklist-pill-<cl:id:date> visible on To-dos tab dated today, no edit/delete buttons rendered for source==='checklist'.
test_results.checklist_tick_via_todos: PASS - toggling a source=checklist row on To-dos tab calls POST /api/checklists/{id}/tick and moves item into Done filter after reload.
test_results.edit_urgent_toggle: PASS - todo-edit-btn opens inline editor with todo-edit-urgent-<id>; unchecking removes pill; re-checking restores it (2 PATCH /api/todos/{id} roundtrips both 200).
test_results.dar_prefill_integration: PASS - after marking 'Renew insurance' done today, GET /api/tasks/dar-prefill returned 200 with body {"text":"✅ Done: Renew insurance\n⏳ Not done: Open the boat shed and log the keys"}. Confirms DarPendingCard will prefill correctly.
test_results.regression_add_toggle_delete: PASS - urgent test todo created, edited twice, and deleted cleanly; existing 'Renew insurance' toggle round-trip works.

critical_code_review_comments: TodosTab.jsx line 153: non-overdue branch shows 'in ${dd}d'. When due_date equals today, dd==0, so text becomes 'Due today' via the earlier ternary (OK). For future dates dd is positive. No bug, but consider using elapsedLabel-style singular ('in 1 day') for polish.

TodosTab.jsx daysSince uses Math.floor over ms diff so day rollover depends on browser TZ vs created_at UTC timestamp; acceptable but a member checking-in near midnight may see 'today' when server day flipped. Not blocking.
backend/routes/tasks.py _pack_todo drops fields correctly and excludes _id (good). Response includes urgent/source/checklist_id/recurrence as spec'd.
test_credentials: exec.test@example.com / Exec@12345 (email login toggle) works and lands on / with sidebar including Task Manager.
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted transient TEST_urgent_iter61_* todo. Toggled 'Renew insurance' done->open (final state = open, matches pre-test).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth token is stored in localStorage under key 'ishowedup_token'. Use it as Bearer for /api calls when scripting fetch. Task Manager route is /tasks; tabs via data-testid tasks-tab-{today|todos|checklists}. Checklist virtual todo IDs use format 'cl:<uuid>:<YYYY-MM-DD>'.
